Aliens have landed on Earth… to run a gas station. Play solo or up to 4 players and do human tasks to blend in. People depend on you, it’s your job to make sure that the shelves have the correct items, refuel customers passing by, and provide food for travelers. But most importantly, you must conduct your research.

STAY UNDETECTED
Your mission is simple. Gather all data you can from humans without their knowledge. Scan, steal, and test various methods on customers while they stop by the gas station. Be careful not to raise the “suspicion meter” too high, as that will trigger the visit of government officials.

BE NORMAL, BE HUMAN
During the day, take care of the gas station as an ordinary employee. Restock the shelves, order wares for the shop, refuel passersby, and exchange goods for cash. At night you will be able to gather your thoughts, and plan for the next day. 

UPGRADE AND CUSTOMIZE
Balance between two missions, upgrading the gas station to attract more customers and upgrading your alien tech to process data and gather information more efficiently. To blend in, draw a very normal human expression on your state-of-the-art disguise.

During closing hours, you can also upgrade the station, inside and outside to make sure everything is going according to plan.
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: Roadside Research is a 1 to 4 player co-op gas station simulator. Except you’re aliens. And undercover. Do very human things like restocking shelves while preparing for the invasion. Just don’t get caught.

Features: Chaotic solo or co-op fun: Gather friends or play alone to manage the gas station while pursuing your alien mission.
Dual Upgrade Path: Manage upgrades for your gas station and for your alien technology at the same time
Satisfying Simulation: Clean, cook, and stock your workplace with all necessary supplies and items to make sure every customer leaves satisfied.
Alien Deception: Make sure to stay disguised and don’t get caught by human government officials. If you are too suspicious, they will turn you into goo.

LocalizedProperties.RecommendedNotes: OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11;Processor: Ryzen 7 2700X / Intel i7-9700K;Memory: 8 GB RAM;Graphics: AMD RX 5600 XT / Nvidia 2060;DirectX: Version 11;Storage: 8 GB available space
LocalizedProperties.ReleaseNotes:
NEW Invasion Stage 1: Unlock Invasion Stage 1 by completing missions. Check your progress and the current mission in the Invasion App in your Alien Room. 

NEW Abduction & Abductor Tablet: Select a customer and note down what they like to synchronize brains. Lead them up to the Abduction Platform and beam them up for Research Points.

NEW Distractor Spawner: Arm it first, throw it second. NPCs will only pay attention to the hologram while it’s playing. It does not raise the suspicion level. 

NEW F.A.R.T.: Unlock the Fully Automated Restocking Technician in the Alien Skill Tree. It unloads the truck, places goods on storage shelves, and refills shelves in the store if you have placed an item on it earlier. It throws away empty boxes.

NEW Placeable Walls: Buy different sizes of placeable walls to redesign your gas station.

NEW Battery system: Unlock an automation upgrade to use the new battery system. Use the portable recharger to load automation batteries. Return empty ones to their station and the Hampter Giuseppe will recharge them.

NEW Universal Box: Buy the Universal Box Dispenser that can only used by players. All store products can be moved around with it.

NEW How To Play App: Your Alien Screen now features the How To Play App, including tutorials to minigames and explanations of features.

NEW Goopster Fridge: Buy a Goopster Fridge to store your Goopster drinks. NPCs will not interact with it. 

NEW Stackable items: Place more products on shelves.
